WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    online_sales.CustomerKey AS customer_key,
    customer.FirstName AS first_name,
    customer.LastName AS last_name,
    MEASURE(online_sales.order_count) AS order_count,

  FROM online_sales
  CROSS JOIN customer
  GROUP BY
    online_sales.CustomerKey,
    customer.FirstName,
    customer.LastName
),
thresholds AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_count) AS order_count_p90,

  cm.order_count,

CROSS JOIN thresholds t

WITH store_year AS (
  SELECT
    st."StoreKey" AS store_key,
    st."StoreName" AS store_name,
    c."CalendarYear" AS yr,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM sales
  CROSS JOIN calendar c
  CROSS JOIN store st
  WHERE c."CalendarYear" IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY st."StoreKey", st."StoreName", c."CalendarYear"
),
store_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2009
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name
),
store_decline AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    sales_2008,
    sales_2009,
    (sales_2008 - sales_2009) AS store_decline_amount,
    (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / NULLIF(CAST(sales_2008 AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) * 100 AS store_decline_pct
  FROM store_pivot
  WHERE sales_2008 > 0
    AND sales_2009 > 0
    AND sales_2009 < sales_2008
),
top_stores AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    store_decline_amount,
    store_decline_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC) AS store_rank
  FROM store_decline
  ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
store_category_year AS (
  SELECT
    st."StoreKey" AS store_key,
    st."StoreName" AS store_name,
    COALESCE(pc."ProductCategoryName", '未知产品') AS category_name,
    c."CalendarYear" AS yr,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM sales
  CROSS JOIN calendar c
  CROSS JOIN store st
  CROSS JOIN product p
  CROSS JOIN product_subcategory ps
  CROSS JOIN product_category pc
  WHERE c."CalendarYear" IN (2008, 2009)
  GROUP BY st."StoreKey", st."StoreName", COALESCE(pc."ProductCategoryName", '未知产品'), c."CalendarYear"
),
store_category_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2009
  FROM store_category_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name, category_name
),
category_decline AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    category_name,
    (sales_2008 - sales_2009) AS category_decline_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY store_key
      ORDER BY (sales_2008 - sales_2009) DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM store_category_pivot
)
SELECT
  t.store_rank AS "名次",
  t.store_name AS "门店",
  ROUND(t.store_decline_amount, 2) AS "门店销售额减少额",
  ROUND(t.store_decline_pct, 2) AS "门店降幅百分比",
  cd.category_name AS "拖累最多的产品品类",
  ROUND(cd.category_decline_amount, 2) AS "该品类销售减少额",
  ROUND(
    cd.category_decline_amount / NULLIF(CAST(t.store_decline_amount AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS "占门店总减少额百分比"
FROM top_stores t
JOIN category_decline cd
  ON cd.store_key = t.store_key
 AND cd.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.store_rank;
turns.assumption: 门店“降幅”按 2008→2009 销售额下降百分比计算，同店指两年都有销售的门店，品类拖累按品类销售额减少额最大判定，产品维度缺失的产品归入“未知产品”。
